title: Waking Yao Lao
summary: Xiao Li opens the Xiao Gate's first pill auction in Feng City, and Black Alliance remnants interrupt it to claim the city. Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin, who had been backing them, recognise Medusa and quickly side with Xiao Yan. Medusa tells Xiao Yan she knows he feeds the Heaven Swallowing Python Amethyst Lion Birth Essence, and presses him for her Soul Recovery Pill. With the herbs from the auction, Xiao Yan spends two months in the mountains refining medicine for Yao Lao's soul, pours all his Dou Qi into waking his master and passes out; Medusa, who swore to kill him herself, catches him as he falls. Yao Lao wakes, warns Medusa off his disciple and sees that she has fully merged with the python's soul. He revives Xiao Yan, and master and disciple meet again after two years.
